verdict.rationale: Leaving looks feasible: server code lives in your own GitHub repository, including template-created repos ([manufact-docs-3], [manufact-docs-22]), you can attach servers hosted elsewhere ([manufact-docs-23]), and proxied servers can be switched back to a direct external connection ([manufact-docs-19]). Platform data such as logs, observability events and captured payloads is reachable through the MCP tools and REST API ([manufact-docs-14], [manufact-docs-17], [manufact-docs-13]), but no data-export feature is documented. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all account data (logs, observability events, payloads, test and checklist results) in open formats, a published API schema (OpenAPI probes return 404), and independent confirmation of migrating off the platform.
